sources.entry: nhs-score-check-action — GitHub Action that fetches your site's agentic readiness score via Not Human Search and fails CI if the score drops. Protects against regressions in your agent-facing surface. MIT.

summary.one_liner: A GitHub Action that fetches a site's agentic readiness score from Not Human Search and can fail a CI build if the score falls below a threshold.
summary.what_it_does: The action takes a domain and queries Not Human Search for that site's agentic readiness score on a 0–100 scale. It checks seven machine-readable signals: llms.txt (25 points), ai-plugin.json (20), OpenAPI spec (20), structured API (15), MCP server verified via live JSON-RPC (10), robots.txt AI rules (5), and Schema.org (5). It can optionally request a fresh crawl before scoring, which adds about 30 seconds. It fails the build if the score is below a configurable minimum (default 50). It outputs the numeric score, a JSON map of detected signals, and a link to the NHS report page, and writes a summary with a per-signal breakdown to the GitHub step summary.
use_cases: Catch regressions in llms.txt or OpenAPI specs during deploys
Scheduled daily check of a site's agent-facing surface
Gate CI builds on a minimum agentic readiness score
Track per-signal AI readiness over time
Embed a live readiness score badge in a README
how_to_run: Add a workflow file under .github/workflows/ with a schedule and workflow_dispatch trigger
In the job, add a step: uses: unitedideas/nhs-score-check-action@v1
Set the 'domain' input to your host (for example example.com, without protocol or path)
Optionally set 'min-score' (default 50) so the build fails when the score is below it
Optionally set 'recrawl: true' to request a fresh crawl first (adds about 30 seconds)
Read outputs score, signals, and report-url in later steps if needed
notable: Scores seven specific machine-readable signals with published point weights
Optional recrawl input to score fresh content before the check
Writes a per-signal breakdown to the GitHub step summary
Exposes score, signals, and report-url as step outputs for downstream use
caveats: Depends on the external Not Human Search service and on the domain being in NHS's index for the badge and scoring
Recrawl adds about 30 seconds of latency per run
The README does not state platform limits beyond GitHub Actions on ubuntu-latest in its example
keywords: check my site for ai agents
